tools.name: support_org_lookup
tools.description: Is this Specified Skilled Worker registered support organization in Japan's official ISA list? Look up by registration number (e.g. 19-000002), part of an organization name (2+ chars), prefecture or language. Returns found, not_in_current_list (seen before; reason not published or inferred), no_matc

tools.name: support_org_changes
tools.description: Which registered support organizations were added to, changed in, dropped from or returned to Japan's official ISA list since a date? From this service's own record of list versions (ISA publishes only the current list). Each change has the registration number, observed_at, last_seen_at, changed fie

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
